title: bot.ability.communication.draft
description: Words of a response the model is still writing (mosfet.py's DraftData, decision D262): text newly written into the words of part part of a bot.ability.communication.respond, after offset characters of it. The generate service returns it while the dispatch call streams, before the selection; the respond that follows is the response of record.

text.description: The words newly written into the part; empty only for a part that ended with no words, which still opens it in order.

offset.description: How many characters of the part's words were written before text.

item.description: The drafted event's index in the dispatch call's events.

part.description: The index of the part in the response's parts.

seq.description: The draft's order among the call's drafts, from 0.

leading.description: On a part's first draft, the fields written before its words (its expression); else empty.
